svg.title: Peaking EQ gain and width
svg.desc: Analog peaking responses on a logarithmic relative-frequency axis. A boost with amplitude ratio 2 has a 6.02 dB peak. Doubling Q narrows it. The reciprocal cut is reflected below zero dB. The boost halfway crossings are at approximately 0.618 and 1.618 times the center for Q=1.
svg.text: A local correction with unchanged ends
Analog response · center amplitude M = 2 · Q = 1, with a narrower Q = 2 comparison
Dots mark halfway gain in dB. Their frequency separation defines the analog bandwidth.
